definitions.data_scope: train fit297 decisions only; source has already seen all385. train385 and noise88 are report-only, not independent confirmation.
definitions.panel48: Fixed36 stable and12 unstable train events. Curves0/64/128 are distinct from fullfit297.
definitions.risk: For per-event time-mean original normalized squared point error:0.8 event mean +0.2 mean of largest max(1,ceil(0.1*n)) event values. Risk is not RMSE.
definitions.common_omega: COI omega=sum_i(M_i*omega_i)/sum_i(M_i), the inertia-weighted mean angular velocity. RMSE unit rad/s; pooled over qualified stable complete8s rows.
definitions.normalized_p: p error divided by unchanged source per-node p_scale; pooled normalized RMSE, dimensionless.
definitions.horizons: Stable complete1/2/5/8s risk cohorts. Panel1/2 risk aggregates existing JSON mean_point_error; official5/8 values preserved. Full report1/2/5/8 values are original published aggregates.
definitions.actual_ranges: unstable_actual_up_to8 and unstable_genuine_up_to15 retain separate names and actual event intervals; no fabricated tails or renamed8s risk.
definitions.timing: Original physical detector, five consecutive confirmation samples at window endpoint,10 history samples concatenated; t=.01*(k-10). Missing real trigger remains NA. CommonT requires qualified identifiable truth/fine/coarse times for every model.
definitions.inference_cost: qualified_inference_seconds_per_event includes paired main/fine history and future RK4 through15s, causal initialization, outputs and metrics, CPU float64 one thread. It is not pure8s deployment inference time.
definitions.P_role: P has48 learned scalars but is not independent capacity matching: its symmetric planar term may be redundant in the original graph cone.
definitions.historical_identity_recovery: Only the exact two retained lock/recovery proofs were excepted. Original fail and frozen metadata preserved; no new process touched or old Job accounting inferred.
